messages:
Anya: Morning team — quick async update from kernel + batching work. I landed the loop-copy elimination and flipped dynamic microbatching on for canary. Quick bench: p50 tokens/sec +7%, p99 latency slightly up. Need a reviewer for PR #3425 and someone to sanity-check long-context (>4k) runs before we promote. Also seeing intermittent KV priming misses during heavy startup: ~3/12 warm sessions missing prefixes. Any volunteers?

Kai: Nice! I can pick up the PR review after standup. Can you paste the exact bench command you used so I can reproduce locally?

Anya: Sure — command: ```./bench_tool --model=redwood-v1 --seq=1024 --concurrency=8 --iters=500``` Results snapshot: p50 62ms -> 57ms, p99 420ms -> 430ms. Memory + L2 spike when concurrency > 12. Will attach full logs.

Mike: Re: KV priming — saw the same pattern on a small canary earlier. Looks like the eviction policy isn't honoring reserved slots used for warmup windows. I pushed a quick fix branch cache-reserve-rc and have a repro in my env. Will open a PR shortly.

Tara: I'm on-call this morning and can run the long-context smoke suite on dedicated infra. If we see regressions we can do a canary rollback.

BuildBot: Deploy succeeded: canary group redwood-v1-variant-2 -> 12 hosts. (ci-6212345660) :white_check_mark:

Kai: @Mike ping me on that PR when ready. @Anya can you add the trace IDs for the missing prefix events? Also +1 on adding an e2e that simulates staggered client warmup to catch this earlier.

Anya: Trace IDs: abc123, def456, ghi789 — attached in the logs. I'll add the e2e and a short unit that asserts reserved-slot semantics. Also I'm +1 for a temporary config bump to increase reserved cache slots for morning traffic while we stabilize.

Mike: Opened PR #3430 with fix + local repro steps and bench run attached. Marked as WIP until Kai and Anya sign off.

Tara: Kicking off long-context runs now against canary; will post results by 10:30am PT. If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback.

Kai: Quick decision on mitigation: I'm +1 for the temporary reserve increase (20% of cache capacity) as an emergency mitigation, roll back in 24h if no regressions. We should also add a telemetry alert for warmup miss rate > 1%.

Anya: Thanks — will update the config, roll canary, and tag PR with the test plan. Blockers: need final review + agreement on the temp reserve number (20% ok?).

Mike: 20% sounds fine to me for now. I'll prioritize the review after lunch.

Anya: Great — tagging this thread for follow-up: I'll post canary metrics and the e2e results once Tara's run finishes. Thanks all :rocket:
